data.exact_reserve_text: At thirty-six months the account has produced a pure loss and prior year underwriting profit together with a small amount of investment income.Overall the result is a profit of $0.05 million (which equates to GBP 0.03 million) which is 0.1% of a stamp capacity of GBP 30 million.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Closed years 2007 to 2012 combined produced a surplus which contributed to the calendar year result and the closing 2013 account result.

prior_year_events.event_name: 2013 year of account prior year underwriting profit
prior_year_events.impact_description: At thirty-six months the 2013 account produced a prior year underwriting profit together with a small amount of investment income; overall result was a profit of $0.05 million.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 was USD 40.081m. The report does not disclose a single explicit gross prior-year reserve movement figure; narrative indicates favourable development on closed years (2007-2012) and a small prior-year profit on the 2013 year. The syndicate states the estimate of total claims liabilities is adequate. Market commentary highlights weaker trading conditions in 2015 (oil price collapse, reduced sums insured and shipment volumes) affecting underwriting but these are described as underwriting/income issues rather than explicit reserve deterioration.
raw_causal_phrases: there were no issues arising from our closed years being 2007 to 2012 and all of these years combined produced a surplus
collapse of the global oil price during 2015
insurance capacity increased which led to more markets chasing fewer, less valuable, shipments with the consequent pressure on rates
the managing agency believes the estimate of total claims liabilities as at 31 December 2015 is adequate
If the provision for net outstanding claims changed by 1%, the impact would equate to a pre-tax movement on net assets/ profits of $402,000

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (2014 comparative) = 40,081 (thousands) -> 40.081 (millions USD). The report does not present an explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure; the claims outstanding reconciliation (note 12) contains 'Claims incurred in prior underwriting year' but that is a P&L construct and was not used per extraction rules. Loss-ratio development table is available (gross %), but underwriting-year gross premiums by year required to convert that into absolute GBP /US$ amounts are not provided, so gross prior-year development could not be computed from the triangle. All monetary amounts are reported in the native report currency (USD).
